verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de exposes a REST API for notarization requests with AI-powered signature/field detection and signer management, which covers document creation and routing for signature, but there is no evidence of NDA-specific templating, an agent drafting document content, or an MCP server for agentic orchestration. missing for 10: evidence of MCP server support, evidence of agent-driven document drafting (vs just submitting pre-made documents), and confirmation of an OpenAPI spec (probe shows 404s) that would enable reliable agent integration.
